text:
3. 2. 10

Upaṭṭhitasatisuttaṃ

394. Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. Katamehi pañcahi: saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottāpī ca hoti, upaṭṭhitasati ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
